before_conditions: A user or integrator calls execute with msg.value greater than the sum of per-call values in the Multicall3 delegatecall batch.
A user or integrator calls pullAndExecute or pullAmountAndExecute and transfers more tokens to the router than are fully spent during the multicall.
The execute, pullAndExecute, and pullAmountAndExecute functions are public and have no automatic refund path.
required_property: The router should not retain any surplus ETH or tokens after execute or pull* calls; any excess value provided by the caller should be returned or otherwise not left stranded on the router, protecting the caller's funds.
bad_outcome: Leftover ETH or tokens remain parked on the router, where they can later be expropriated by public draining vectors, unintentionally exposing user funds.
